official_description: ORCA Multi-Horizon Weather Model v4.0 trained on verified ECMWF reanalysis and operational analysis data, with source-specific provenance.

data_provenance_by_date.1980-01-01 to 2023-12-31: ECMWF ERA5 Consolidated Reanalysis [REANALYSIS] (94.2% of dataset)
data_provenance_by_date.2024-01-01 to 2026-06-30: ECMWF ERA5T Preliminary Reanalysis [REANALYSIS (PRELIMINARY ERA5T)] (5.3% of dataset)
data_provenance_by_date.2026-07-01 to 2026-09-16: ECMWF IFS Operational Analysis [OPERATIONAL_ANALYSIS] (0.5% of dataset)

persistence_comparison: LightGBM benchmarked against genuine persistence baseline across all evaluation horizons
leakage_safeguards: Strict temporal separation with 72h horizon boundary buffers, targets measured at future t+h, input lags measured strictly at or before t, zero forward contamination
derived_variables_note: wave_height_m and wave_period_s are derived using the oceanographic Pierson-Moskowitz formula and are NOT direct ERA5 observations.
